lines.en: I creep between the cracks, back bent.
My robe drags on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边念着什么。
lines.en: I mutter as I walk.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁的凹处钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out of a hollow in the rock.
I keep to shadow, away from light.
My steps are small and quick.
I go around a stalactite.
I shuffle deeper into the valley.
I feel the wall as I go.
My hood hangs low.

lines.zh: 我在火把边上停了一下。
lines.en: I pause by a torch.
My fingers draw shapes in the air.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根，往烛火背面走。
lines.en: I follow the wall's base toward the back of the candlelight.
My bare feet pad on the stone.
I circle the altar half way.
My voice drops lower.
I crouch, muttering words.
I arrange a pile of small stones.
There's no face under my hood.

lines.zh: 我嗅到火把的烟，缩了缩脖子。
lines.en: I smell torch smoke and shrink my neck.
I stare at a distant torch.
I draw a circle slowly.
I wait for a rite to begin.

lines.zh: 我数着幽暗蛾翅膀的拍动。
lines.en: I count the wingbeats of the gloom moth.

lines.zh: 我把一块布条系在腕上。
lines.en: I tie a strip of cloth to my wrist.
I shake the dust from my robe。

lines.zh: 我把手伸进土里，慢慢掏。
lines.en: I reach into the soil and dig slowly.
I listen to water inside the rock.
You've brought light.
I shrink back toward the wall.
My hood turns toward you.
The torchlight makes me cringe.
Will you join the rite?

lines.zh: 你身上没有黑暗的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of the dark.
I watch you from under my hood.
This valley doesn't welcome you.
You're standing in the light.
I withdraw slowly into shadow.
My hood is pulled askew.
It hurts; I shrink into a crack.

lines.zh: 布条从裂口垂下来，我缠回去。
lines.en: A strip hangs from the tear; I wrap it back.

lines.zh: 兜帽底下，声音像石头磨石头。
lines.en: Under my hood, the sound is stone grinding stone.

lines.zh: 我扶着祭坛的边，慢慢蹲下。
lines.en: I grip the altar's edge and crouch slowly.
I retreat behind the altar.

lines.zh: 火把的光，让我的手指抖。
lines.en: Torchlight makes my fingers tremble.
I misspoke the words.
Your hand is steadier than I guessed.
I must go back below.
I want to pinch that flame out.

lines.zh: 你的灯在晃，我躲进土里。
lines.en: Your torch sways — I burrow under.
I creep toward the light source.
When the light dies, I'm closer.
I fear the light, so I tear down torches.

lines.zh: 这点亮，让我浑身不舒服。
lines.en: That brightness makes my skin crawl.

lines.zh: 我退到石柱后面，遮住眼睛。
lines.en: I retreat behind the pillar and cover my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的手伸向火苗，又缩回来。
lines.en: My hand reaches for the flame and pulls back.
Just a little closer.
I'll remember this spot.
You bump me and I dart aside.

lines.zh: 袍子擦过岩壁，蹭下一层灰。
lines.en: My robe brushes the rock, scraping off a layer of dust.
My robe catches your leg.

lines.zh: 我的赤脚在碎石上打滑。
lines.en: My bare feet slip on the loose gravel.
We collide and my robe sweeps up dust.
You step on my foot and I flinch.
I duck behind the pillar.
That knocked my hood crooked.

lines.zh: 我弓着背，从你膝边挤过。
lines.en: I duck through beside your knee, back arched.
My fingers touch your hand.

lines.zh: 另一个兜帽从暗处过来。
lines.en: Another hood comes out of the dark.
Our hands meet.
Its robe is older than mine.
We speak the same words together.

lines.zh: 它把一块石头放在我掌心。
lines.en: It sets a stone in my palm.
We lie shoulder to shoulder on the stone.

lines.zh: 两根手指同时指向一处。
lines.en: Two fingers point to the same spot.
In the dark we need no light.
Together we finish the circle.
This rite needs two.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块黑色的石头。
lines.en: I pick up a black stone.
I wind this cloth round my hand.
One hit, and I sink back underground.

lines.zh: 这块黑石不够圆，仪式用不上。
lines.en: This black stone isn't round enough for the rite.

lines.zh: 我用袍角裹住它，再捡起来。
lines.en: I wrap my robe corner around it, then lift it.
I press it by the altar.
The offering is mine to keep.
I sniff it. Very faint.

lines.zh: 祭品要藏在火把照不到的缝里。
lines.en: Offerings hide in cracks the torches can't reach.
This will serve as an offering.
You came with light.
I raise my hood a little.
My fingers begin to trace.
There should be no light here.
You've interrupted the rite.
I shift forward a body's width.
I'll put out that torch.
Everyone in the valley heard.
Go on, back into the light.
I've noted the ground beneath you.
I follow along the rock's base.
You walk, and I follow under the floor.
I wait at the edge of the light.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石笋背后，只露兜帽。
lines.en: I crouch behind a stalagmite, only my hood showing.
I slip around behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我数着你走过几块石板。
lines.en: I count the flagstones you cross.
The hollow's candles. I put them out first.
I wait for you to switch hands.
I know every dark place here.
Your breaths come shallower.
I claw at you from behind.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划过你的护腕，带走布。
lines.en: My nails rake your bracer and take cloth with them.
My fingers grip your sleeve.
You turn and I'm in the crack.

lines.zh: 我从地下钻出来抓你的腿。
lines.en: I come up from below at your leg.
That one came with nails.
You retreat; I creep after.
I bite your bracer.
My chest heaves with every breath.
Your torch has dipped.
Whispering comes from a crack.

lines.zh: 我从地底钻出半个身子。
lines.en: I rise half out of the ground.
Another hood joins this place.
Someone crouches by the altar.
My bare feet land on stone.
I step out from behind a stalactite.

lines.zh: 我的袍子先出现，然后是我。
lines.en: My robe appears first, then me.
The valley torches dim for a moment.
I begin to draw the circle.
I pull my hood lower.
Fire's light makes my skin shrink.

lines.zh: 我从石台上摔下来，袍子散了。
lines.en: I fall off the ledge and my robe scatters.

lines.zh: 水灌进兜帽里，我闷住了。
lines.en: Water fills my hood and I smother.

lines.zh: 爆风过后，我的兜帽里全是灰。
lines.en: After the blast, ash fills my hood.
An arrow pins my robe.
The spell's glare drives me to the ground.
I've had no offering in a long while.
Lightning flashes and I sink into the ground.
The void drags me downward.
